notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: Qwen2-32B-Instruct backbone (config architectures Qwen2ForCausalLM, model_type qwen2, hidden 5120, 40 query heads): 64 layers x 8 KV heads x head_dim 128 (5120 / 40) x 2 (K,V) x 2 B; the config torch_dtype is float16, which is also 2 B, so = 262,144 B/token. use_cache=false in the config is a training-time flag, not a geometry change. Context 32,768 = max_position_embeddings, rope_scaling null.
